definitions.short: a departure from right , i.e. sin
definitions.full: H7846. set [ סֵט שֵׂט, ] noun [masculine] swerver, revolter (?), deeds that swerve (from the right?); — plural הֶעֱמִיקוּ שֵׂטִים וְשַׁחֲטָה Hosea 5:2 and revolters have gone deep is slaughter (or שַׁחֲתָה in corruption ), but dubious; We Bae Now GASm, compare Gu Kau, {abbrev } הֶע הַשִּׁטִּים וְשַׁחַת and the pit of Shittim they have made deep ; סֵטִים עֲשׂה Psa 101:3 to do deeds that swerve I hate.
